newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil state sees power distributors' sale in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil state sees power distributors' sale in Oct.

text.p: The southern Brazilian state of Rio Grande do Sul hopes to privatize in October two power distributors to be spun off from its electrical utility Cia Estadual de Energia Eletrica (CEEE).
"No date has been set but it is imagined for October," a spokeswoman for the state's Energy Secretariat said.

Consultants advising on the sale of CEEE spinoffs are due to finish their economic evaluation and privatization model Thursday and preliminary bid specifications are to be published by August 20, she said.
State officials plan to split CEEE into six companies in all - two power generators, a transmission firm and three electricity distributors.

Rio Grande do Sul would retain control of a hydroelectric generating firm, a distributor and the transmission firm while a thermal power generator will go to the federal government in lieu of debts, she said.
The state's Energy, Mines and Communication Secretary Assis de Souza and company President Pedro Bisch Neto returned Monday from a roadshow in Europe and the United States on CEEE, it added.
